title: The Headlands House — 3 acres above Point Reyes
audience: buyer's agent packet for a $4.8M single-family listing
core_points: A 1947 ranch-style home rebuilt in 2018, 3.1 acres with unobstructed ocean views
4 bedrooms, 3 baths, 3,840 sqft; detached 600 sqft studio with its own entrance
Architect: Maren Thole, local, known for restorations that keep the bones
Materials: reclaimed douglas fir floors, hand-troweled lime plaster, clay tile roof
Systems: solar with battery backup, 40-yard cistern, radiant floor throughout
Land notes: 27 mature coastal oaks, a year-round spring, state-protected viewshed
Neighborhood: 14 minutes to Inverness ferry, 38 to Point Reyes Station, 75 to SF
Recent comparable sales: 3 in the last 18 months, median $4.65M, days-on-market 42
Pricing strategy: list at $4.8M, expect offers in first 3 weekends of open houses
Next steps for the agent: preview Friday 3-5pm, photography finalizes Tuesday, listing goes live Friday
